scientific_integrity: Acyclic matching certificate and independent finite homology cross-check available as a standalone script; analytic deduction from the Morse critical dimensions proves the integral homotopy type.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the icosahedral graph, r>=3, nonequivariantly; no persistence maps, no other graph family, no independent mathematical audit. r>=7 is an elementary skeleton consequence. Equivalent unindexed work remains a research risk.
title: Higher-independence homotopy of the icosahedral graph beyond the two-vertex stage
